Add as many properties as you like and manage them all from one dashboard.

HOW IT WORKS

From a printed QR display to a wall full of memories.
Put the QR display out

One QR kit per property. It goes on the counter, in the welcome folder, or by the door.

Guests scan on arrival

The wall opens in the browser. Wi-Fi, trash day and your local favorites are pinned to the top.

Notes arrive, screened

Photos and messages pass automated screening before they publish. Anything borderline waits for you.

WHAT HOSTS GET

A guestbook, a house manual and a moderation queue.

Everything below is in both plans. There is no feature tier to decode.

01
Your house manual, pinned

Wi-Fi, trash days, appliance quirks, checkout steps and recommendations sit above the wall, so the questions stop arriving.

02
A wall guests actually use

A mobile-first run of photos and notes from every stay, added from a browser tab in under a minute.

03
One dashboard, every property

Curate, pin, hide and delete across all your properties, with clear active and unpaid states.

“Staying at a friend’s house” is a feeling. It comes from good information, a warm welcome, and the sense that other people loved this place too.
WHY WE BUILT IT

WHY IT MATTERS

A stay that feels considered is a stay people talk about.

Create a more memorable guest experience—one that may encourage guests to share more positive feedback on their official booking platform.

DigiStayBook never asks guests for a rating, never pre-fills a review and never links into a booking provider’s review form. Improved feedback is a possible indirect benefit of a better stay, not a guaranteed outcome.

PRICING

One price per property. Choose monthly or annual billing.
28-day free trial on your first property.

Create your account and add your first property to activate your 28-day free trial.

Everything included, billed monthly. Cancel from your dashboard in one click.

Seabreeze Cottage
St Anthony's Head, Cornwall
AT
Welcome to the cottage

YOUR HOSTS,
Ana & Tom

The kettle is on the side and there is milk in the fridge. Everything you need for the week is below, and the sunset from the back deck is worth waiting for.

A LITTLE TIP FROM YOUR HOSTS

Our favorite: the bakery behind the lighthouse. Go before 9am or the pasties are gone.

Your stay essentials

Quick links to the key information for your stay.

Wi-Fi
Trash
Checkout
Heating

MORE FROM YOUR HOSTS

We lay the fire before every arrival, so it is ready to go on your first night. The kindling lives in the copper bucket and there is a note inside the cupboard door if you have never lit one. Get it going early — the whole cottage holds the heat by supper.

Ana & Tom

The bench at the end of the garden gets the last of the sun. We have watched a lot of evenings go from there, and the bakery on the lane opens at seven if you want to take breakfast down with you.

Ana & Tom

8 memories left here

We walked to the lighthouse every morning and stopped at the little bakery on the way back. Four days of sea air and we already want to come back.

MS
Mia & Sam

Thank you for the log fire instructions taped inside the cupboard. Perfect first night after a five hour drive.

TA
The Aldridges

Third year running. The garden is somehow better every time. The kids spent the entire week hunting for the frog by the pond and found him twice.

P
Priya

Tip for whoever stays next: the low tide walk out to the sandbar is worth setting an alarm for.

E
Ellis

We got engaged on the back deck on our last evening. Thank you for keeping it quiet when we asked, and for leaving the good glasses out.

JR
Jonah & Rae

Rained for six days. Did not matter. There are more board games in that cupboard than in our house.

TO
The Okonjos

My mother stayed here in the eighties when it was her aunt's place. She sat in the window seat for an hour and did not say much. Thank you for looking after it.

C
Cathy

Long table, nine of us, far too much crab. Best night of the year.

MF
Marek & family
